productionPrinciple: DESIGN → ASSET → CALIBRATION → HUMAN GATE → RUNTIME → VISUAL QA. No current-runtime polish sequence may substitute for canonical convergence.

generationStrategy.rule: No model is production-locked. Run a documented availability probe and compare candidates against the Canonical Target before selecting a source.

methods.preferred: built-in image generation with transparent output, then deterministic alpha/anchor normalization
alternates: gpt-image-2 through an approved API/CLI path if current capability and alpha workflow are verified
Codyssey Public API if available and provenance can be recorded

methods.preferred: candidate comparison across built-in image generation and any verified gpt-image-2 or gemini-2.5-flash-image workflow
methods.selection: projection, scale, material and edge QA at native scale; not model reputation

methods.preferred: small coherent batches, repair existing assets when acceptance criteria pass
alternates: hand-authored/procedural geometry for simple rails, ropes and gangway elements

methods.preferred: large-format independent environment layers generated from the Canonical Target direction
methods.constraint: never one scene plate and never a gameplay/collision source

generationStrategy.provenance: Record model/API, prompt/reference role, candidate ID, source size, alpha result, normalization steps, reviewer and gate decision beside each selected asset.

visual: Canonical Target style and elevated-oblique projection
correct target scale and landmark hierarchy
consistent warm daylight, blue/gold accents and Mediterranean material language
no malformed architecture/rigging, text artifacts, baked UI or unwanted background
technical: source resolution sufficient for target dimensions without upscaling
clean edges and normalized transparent padding
no pixel-derived collision or scene-plate dependency

assetDecision.KEEP: existing asset meets every visual and technical condition at target scale
assetDecision.REPAIR: one localized, bounded defect can be corrected without changing projection, silhouette family or source quality
assetDecision.REGENERATE: projection/scale/material/silhouette/alpha failure, or two repair attempts fail

calibrationGate.rule: No runtime rebuild begins before Human approval of the complete calibration sheet.

humanGates.name: Landmark candidate selection
humanGates.approves: Hall, Workshop and Hero Ship source candidates

humanGates.name: Foundation / Fleet visual integration
humanGates.approves: support fleet, foundation, scenic and foreground direction

humanGates.name: Runtime geometry
humanGates.approves: new Blueprint-derived geometry before art completion

humanGates.name: Canonical runtime comparison
humanGates.approves: phase captures compared against the Canonical Target

captureSpecs: 1280×720 gameplay follow captures at P1, P5 and P7 using approved 1.0 zoom/deadzone contract
canonicalComparison.method: Open Canonical and actual runtime captures; make fixed-coordinate crops/contact sheets; inspect against the brief; collect console/exception evidence. The question is canonical convergence, not whether the current runtime improved.

driftStopRules: scene plate or pixel-derived collision reintroduced

retryAndRollback.retry: Generate candidates → compare → decide repairability. After two failed repairs, regenerate. If the same failure repeats, change model, prompt, reference treatment or generation method rather than continuing patches.
retryAndRollback.rollback: Version all candidates. Never overwrite a Human-approved source; retain its manifest/provenance and revert to it after a failed experiment. A failed runtime phase reverts to the last approved phase checkpoint, then produces a Drift Report before resuming.
retryAndRollback.driftReport: Stop implementation, attach Canonical/runtime comparison and state the violated metric, suspected cause, rejected workaround and proposed correction. Human direction is required before changing the Canonical contract.

skillsApplied.environment-art: Sets landmark hierarchy, readable silhouettes, material cohesion, player-relative scale and protected-harbor composition criteria.
skillsApplied.create-game-assets: Defines staged candidate production, asset manifest/provenance, technical alpha/pivot QA and native-scale calibration before engine integration.
skillsApplied.portfolio-world-visual-qa: Requires opened actual runtime captures, fixed crop comparison, Visual Brief checks and console evidence; no runtime Visual Pass is claimed by this plan.
